name: Deniz Yilmaz
bio:
Deniz's journey into motorsport began unconventionally. While studying mechanical engineering at Istanbul Technical University, he became obsessed with optimizing the university's solar car racing team. This passion led him to an internship at a small Turkish rally team, where he quickly proved his organizational and technical skills, coordinating test sessions and managing driver feedback. His meticulous approach to data analysis and ability to translate driver concerns into actionable engineering adjustments caught the eye of a Cadillac Racing scout.

Now, as a test driver coordinator for Cadillac Racing, Deniz excels at building strong relationships with drivers and engineers alike. He is known for his relentless pursuit of improvement and his ability to identify subtle performance gains through rigorous testing. He believes in fostering a transparent and communicative environment, ensuring all team members are aligned and working towards shared goals. Deniz's demanding nature stems from his unwavering commitment to excellence, pushing both himself and those around him to achieve peak performance.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight fade on the sides.
physical.description: Deniz has a focused look about him, with sharp features and a lean build suggesting an active lifestyle.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen for jotting down observations.
Insists on starting every test session with a thorough briefing, even if everyone is familiar with the plan.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
